pulses.name: TSEC Honeypot: Malware Delivery - Week of 2026-10-19
pulses.description: Honeypot-observed malware delivery activity for the week of 2026-10-19. Contains 2508 indicators (19 FileHash-SHA256, 2444 IPv4, 45 URL). Payload delivery: droppers, botnet nodes and the files they fetched. Services targeted: HTTPS/TLS web, SSH/Telnet, HTTP, SSH, web application, credential services. Sectors targeted: healthcare, water-wastewater-systems, technology, energy, financial-services, government. Families: mozi. IPv4 and URL indicators expire after 30 days, file hashes after 90; re-observed sources are refreshed. Data sourced from the TSEC T-Pot honeypot network.
